info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Counterparty Management API
info.description: The Counterparty Management API allows users to update the details of counterparties in a banking system. This API facilitates the modification of existing counterparty information such as contact details, credit limits, and compliance data. Ideal for financial institutions and firms managing extensive counterparty relationships, this endpoint specifically supports critical updates that ensure compliance and operational efficiency. Developers can leverage this API to maintain accurate counterparty records as part of their risk management and trading operations.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a specific counterparty identified by the given ID. Ensure to provide the necessary fields in the request to successfully modify the counterparty's information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of the specified counterparty identified by PARTY-600045. Ensure that all required fields are included as per the schema to successfully apply the changes.
